text: {"name":"llm_reset_notify","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a Bluetooth link-layer reset notification by dispatching an event on a non-zero status byte and otherwise copying reset-related fields from the LL descriptor to the connection context while managing the associated IRQ/HCI notification.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a2":"reset_msg","v3":"status","v4":"conn_tbl_base","v5":"ll_desc_tbl_base","v6":"conn_ptr","v7":"ll_desc_idx","v8":"ll_desc_ptr","v13":"ll_desc_flags","v14":"ll_desc_ptr","v20":"conn_ptr","_frame.v51":"conn_idx"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"reset notification status/event byte (non-zero dispatches event 1)"},{"offset":1,"meaning":"connection index selected by reset notification"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"connection flags updated during reset notify (bits 0, 1, and 6)"},{"offset":34,"meaning":"link-layer descriptor index stored in connection context"},{"offset":472,"meaning":"link-layer descriptor flags word used to gate field copies and connection flags"}]}
